title: All Season Sleeveless Sleep Sack Walker 1.0 TOG - Organic Cotton & Camel Wool - Cream - 18M-3T / 1.0 TOG
description: Camel Wool Sleeveless Walker Sleep Sack 1.0 TOG Experience the ultimate in organic and safe with our camel wool sleeveless walker sleep sack, which has a 1.0 TOG rating for year-round comfort. It's made from premium camel wool filling for natural warmth, perfect for active little ones. This luxurious sleep solution will ensure a restful night's sleep for babies. Outer: organic cotton Filling: 28.5% camel wool + 1.5% camel hair + 70% SORONA polyester Organic cotton sleep sacks with camel wool filling make all seasons ease. Organic cotton Outer for safety and comfort; GOTS Certification ensures transparency and traceability. Features a temperature-sensing reminder. FSC certified, with a recycling package - supporting Earth's sustainability.
